title: 6.5 Simple Directions
unit_outcome: Name places in town and ways to travel, say where places are, give simple directions, say what you can and cannot do, ask for help, and read simple bus and train times.
goal: Understand and give five short directions: go straight, turn left, turn right, cross the street and stop.
grammar_function: Imperatives: Go straight. Turn right. Cross the street. Stop at the bank.
